title: The Vietnam War
text: The Vietnam War (1955–1975) was a prolonged conflict in which communist North Vietnam and the Viet Cong fought against South Vietnam and its principal ally, the United States. The U.S. entered direct military involvement in the early 1960s under Presidents Kennedy and Johnson, escalating to 543,000 troops by 1969. The war was deeply unpopular in the United States, leading to massive anti-war protests. The Tet Offensive (1968) undermined public confidence in U.S. strategy. U.S. forces withdrew following the Paris Peace Accords (1973). North Vietnam captured Saigon on April 30, 1975, reunifying Vietnam under communist rule. The war claimed approximately 58,000 American lives and up to 3 million Vietnamese lives.
